chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Health of the body comes from paucity of envy.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between envy and physical health in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) establishes a profound psychosomatic link, suggesting that the spiritual disease of hasad (envy) manifests physically as illness. This teaching aligns with the Shia tradition of 'al-Amrad al-Ruhaniyya' (spiritual diseases), where purifying the heart from internal vices is seen as essential for holistic well-being. It underscores the practical implication that moral hygiene is not merely ethical but a prerequisite for physical vitality.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 256. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
Health of body comes from paucity of envy. [1]
